observation.command:
echo "=== Seeded rows in Postgres (via docker exec) ==="
docker exec urbo-workspace-urbo-backend-postgres-1 psql -U postgres -d urbo -tAc "SELECT 'events='||count(*) FROM event; SELECT 'news='||count(*) FROM news; SELECT 'poi='||count(*) FROM poi;" 2>&1 | head
echo "=== Keycloak realm present ==="
docker exec urbo-workspace-keycloak-1 curl -s -o /dev/null -w "kc /realms/urbo: %{http_code}\n" http://127.0.0.1:8080/realms/urbo 2>&1 | head
echo "=== Keycloak admin user / clients seeded? ==="
docker exec urbo-workspace-keycloak-1 curl -s http://127.0.0.1:8080/realms/urbo 2>/dev/null | head -c 150; echo
